### FeedWatch

```ts
type FeedWatch<T> = (onChange, signal) => Disposer | Promise<Disposer>;
```

Start a live feed, calling `onChange` with each snapshot until `signal` aborts;
the returned (or resolved) Disposer tears it down.

### optimisticMutation()

```ts
function optimisticMutation<TData, TVars, TResult>(
  options,
): WithRequired<
  UseMutationOptions<
    TResult,
    AppError,
    TVars,
    | {
        previous: TData;
        optimistic: TData | undefined;
      }
    | undefined
  >,
  "mutationKey"
>;
```

Optimistic writes for one cache entry, followed by owner reconciliation. Apply
must return new data. Concurrent writes to this key run in order; queued writes
wait for reconciliation instead of stacking rollback snapshots.
